existing_error_scope: The unchanged standard smoke requestfailed collector ignores errorText matching ERR_ABORTED; all other request failures enter its errors list. This is the existing source policy, not a new exemption introduced by this task.
strict_world_limit: These renderer smoke outcomes do not retrospectively exempt or qualify the original strict door/world six abort failures. Forensic/world NONPASS and release=false remain separate.
